title: EVEN rounds away from zero to an even integer: 1.5 gives 2, 3 gives 4, 2 stays 2, -1 gives -2
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "a", EVEN ( 1.5 ), "b", EVEN ( 3 ), "c", EVEN ( 2 ), "d", EVEN ( -1 ) )

source.quote: Regardless of the sign of number, a value is rounded up when adjusted away from zero. If number is an even integer, no rounding occurs.
source.supports: the table of examples gives 2, 4, 2 and -2 for these four formulas

source.quote: Returns number rounded up to the nearest even integer.
source.supports: Return values: a single integer value
